<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 8"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Sanctify Armament](/Feats.aspx?ID=4671) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Cleric" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=554" />
<trait label="Divine" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=48" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 117

**Prerequisites**
holy or unholy trait

</column>

---

You touch a weapon and bring it into concordance with your deity. For 1 round, that weapon gains your holy or unholy trait. It also deals an additional 2d6 spirit damage to creatures of the opposed trait. For example, if you are holy, the weapon would deal an extra 2d6 spirit damage to unholy creatures.

If you use Sanctify Armament again, any previous use of it expires.

<title level="2">Sanctify Armament leads to...</title>
[Lasting Armament](/Feats.aspx?ID=4690)
name: Sanctify Armament
